text: Confirmed ERASE wildcard expansion defect filed as #6589. VFP9 SP2 docs explicitly document wildcard filenames and installed VFP COM ERASE *.tmp deletes both matching files while retaining a nonmatch; Copperfin runtime host successfully completes ERASE erase_mask("*.tmp") but leaves both matches. This isolates wildcard expansion from #6582 bare-filename expression parsing. Issue has been verified OPEN and owner-authored, with bug/runtime/agent-approved labels. No production changes.
